verification: Five presentation stills rendered in Cycles on the OptiX device after a device test (480x300, 24 samples, 7.8 s, RTX 4060). All five are 1920x1200, 128 samples with denoising and adaptive sampling, 30-36 s each, and each was opened and inspected: hero_01_district, hero_02_bridge, hero_03_singa, hero_04_internatio, hero_05_kembang. Compositions were changed because the review cameras were not suitable as stills: CAM_HERO_BRIDGE was added at (-26,-68,4.6) aimed at the crossing from downstream, because the on-deck CAM_BRIDGE framed a blank massing box instead of the bridge; CAM_DISTRICT_OVERVIEW was moved to (-260,-380,420) with a 40 mm lens after two prior framings revealed the finite edge of the ground plane; CAM_KEMBANG_STREET was moved to the west footway at 1.75 m with a 32 mm lens so shopfronts rather than roadway fill the frame. output/camera_setup.json was updated to the live values including palagan_target_xyz, which had drifted from the true aim on two cameras. Water roughness was raised 0.085 to 0.20 and re-applied so the far river stops reading as a flat white band at grazing angles. The master was re-saved and reopens with operation id hero-renders-02, 138 objects and 9 cameras. Not corrected and left visible: the neutral review sky reads overcast rather than sunny, the right bank in hero_02 and the bridgehead massings are blank approximate volumes, and no Cycles quality pass was attempted beyond these settings.
